The rate limiter is `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`. Ten files import from it: nine source files import `consumeRateLimit`, and one test file imports the bucket table, config lookup, plan setter, and test-only reset as well.

- **`consumeRateLimit` only:**
  - `src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts`
  - `src/server/services/search-service.ts`
  - `src/server/services/invitation-service.ts`
  - `src/server/services/comment-service.ts`
  - `src/server/services/auth-service.ts`
  - `src/actions/auth/login.ts`
  - `src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts`
  - `src/actions/auth/reset-password.ts`
  - `src/actions/members/invite-member.ts`
- **Test file, imports `RATE_LIMIT_BUCKETS`, `consumeRateLimit`, `getBucketConfig`, `resetRateLimits`, `setOrgPlan`:** `tests/lib/rate-limit.test.ts`

Nothing outside that test file imports the bucket table, `getBucketConfig`, `setOrgPlan`, or `resetRateLimits`.

I left out four test files that mention `"@/lib/rate-limit"` only inside `vi.mock(...)` calls: `tests/server/plan-limits.test.ts`, `tests/services/search-service.test.ts`, `tests/services/comment-service.test.ts`, and `tests/services/invitation-service.test.ts`. They import `rateLimitState` from `tests/server/_support/doubles/misc.ts`, not from the module. If you count mock declarations as imports, add those four. I also excluded `src/actions/_lib/action-errors.ts` (a comment only) and the `scripts/` and `corpus-manifest.json` metadata entries, which describe the module as text rather than importing it.

I searched by the `rate-limit` path string and by each exported symbol name. `src/lib` has no barrel file, and the `@/*` alias resolves to `./src/*`, so no other import path can reach the module.

ANSWER: src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/auth-service.ts, src/actions/auth/login.ts, src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts, src/actions/auth/reset-password.ts, src/actions/members/invite-member.ts, tests/lib/rate-limit.test.ts
